name: find-in-files
title: find-in-files
description: Find identifiers and text in JavaScript and TypeScript syntax trees under a required root.

settings.name: path
settings.description: Optional folder scope inside root; omitted means root.

settings.name: name
settings.description: Text to match; filename for file finders, source text for content, module specifier for imports.

settings.name: type
settings.description: File extension with or without a dot, or folder for location finder.

settings.name: db
settings.description: Read saved discovery inventory instead of crawling folders.

settings.name: save_path
settings.description: Existing folder for optional JSON and text reports.

settings.name: save_file
settings.description: Optional report filename stem without extension.

settings.name: kind
settings.description: Optional TypeScript SyntaxKind, such as Identifier or ImportDeclaration.
